system.description:
Failures kick back with unwanted side effects. Source: BESM4e.

  • Level 1: The Backlash occurs if the character fails their roll by an extreme margin (6 or more)
  • Level 2: The Backlash occurs if the character fails their roll by a significant margin (3 or more)
  • Level 3: The Backlash occurs if the character fails their roll
